title: processkit diagnostic
description: One diagnostic as carried in the result envelope (cli@v1 PK-OUT-007). The same shape is used by every processkit command. The owning specification of a code assigns its category.

code.description: Stable code '<area>.<condition>', for example cli.plan-stale or storage.target-not-committed. The first segment names the owning area.

category.description: Exit category. Only diagnostics with severity error decide the exit code.

message.description: What happened, in one sentence, redacted.

file.description: Repository-relative path with '/' separators, or '-' for standard input.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the file or draft.

constraint.description: Identifier of the violated constraint, for example a schema keyword path.

evidence.description: Redacted structured facts that support the diagnostic.

fix.description: How to fix the problem, in one sentence.

nextAction.description: Machine-readable next action from a closed set.
